title: GunLord
text:
GunLord is a platform / run'n gun game developed by NG:Dev.Team, a German indie team. Initially designed for MVS (arcade) and AES (Neo Geo), the game was ported on Sega Dreamcast as well.

Gameplay
It's a Turrican-like where the player explores waste lands while blasting enemies.
